# Personal Finance Visualization Plan

Your budget is steady on income and rent, while variable spending is drifting up in groceries and dining. The best visuals here are a stacked bar chart for monthly spending mix and a savings-rate line chart to show how much of income you keep each month.

## Chart-Ready Budget Breakdown

### Monthly category totals
| Category | Jan | Feb | Mar | Trend |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Rent | 1400 | 1400 | 1400 | Flat |
| Groceries | 420 | 460 | 510 | Rising |
| Transport | 120 | 135 | 110 | Mixed |
| Dining | 260 | 240 | 300 | Rising |
| Entertainment | 90 | 110 | 95 | Slightly up |
| Utilities | 180 | 165 | 175 | Stable |
| Savings | 500 | 450 | 400 | Falling |
| Income | 3200 | 3200 | 3200 | Flat |

### Chart plan
- **Stacked bar chart**
  - X-axis: Jan, Feb, Mar
  - Y-axis: USD
  - Stack: Rent, Groceries, Transport, Dining, Entertainment, Utilities, Savings
  - Use a separate color for **Savings** so the decline is easy to spot
- **Savings-rate line chart**
  - Formula: **Savings rate = Savings ÷ Income**
  - Jan: **15.6%**
  - Feb: **14.1%**
  - Mar: **12.5%**
  - Plot as a single line with markers

## Fastest-Growing Category and Budget Adjustment

### Growth check
| Category | Jan | Feb | Mar | Change Jan→Mar | Fastest? |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Groceries | 420 | 460 | 510 | +90 | Yes |
| Dining | 260 | 240 | 300 | +40 | No |
| Entertainment | 90 | 110 | 95 | +5 | No |
| Utilities | 180 | 165 | 175 | -5 | No |
| Transport | 120 | 135 | 110 | -10 | No |

**Fastest-growing category:** **Groceries**
- Increase from Jan to Mar: **+$90**
- Growth rate: **+21.4%**

### Suggested budget adjustment
- Cap **Dining** at **$250/month** and move the extra **$50–$60** into **Savings**
- Reason: savings fell from **$500 → $400** even though income stayed flat
- This keeps lifestyle flexibility while protecting your savings rate

## Short Insight Summary
- Your **fixed costs are stable**, but **variable spending is creeping up**.
- **Groceries** is the clearest inflation pressure point.
- **Savings rate is declining** each month, which is the main warning signal.
- A small reallocation from dining or entertainment back to savings would help restore momentum.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Savings Calculator] https://www.investor.gov/financial-tools-calculators/calculators/savings-goal-calculator

## Sources
- Budgeting basics: https://www.consumer.gov/content/make-budget
- Savings rate concept: https://www.investor.gov/financial-tools-calculators/calculators/savings-goal-calculator
